text:
sanjay: Heads up — ZionCompute NDA is signed and their devkit ships next week. want to kick off a short pilot to validate integration and surface any runtime regressions.

maria: awesome, congrats. what's the scope of the pilot? perf only or also packaging for marketplace?

sanjay: perf + basic infra packaging. two tracks: 1) run our standard inference suite on the devkit (latency, p95/p99, throughput, mem) 2) create a minimal Terraform + Helm flow for their instance so we can list a verified image in marketplace later.

olivia: for the suite: can we use the trimmed eval set (50 prompts) we used for Ampere? smaller than full CI but representative. should catch regressions fast.

sanjay: yes — use the trimmed eval. target run: 3 warmup runs, then 10 measured, with KV cache cleared between models. record token-per-second, p95, p99, and stderr.

alex: sound plan. I'll allocate a dev-runtime pool and add a transient route. need the devkit IPs and an ssh user. also: set sequence_length=1024 for parity with our hosted tests.

priya-legal: quick note — NDA has a 30-day embargo on joint public messaging. Zion requested microbench numbers in the partner portal; we'll share internal results but hold anything public until we agree.

maria: thanks Priya. for internal sync: propose milestones — (A) devkit arrival & smoke (day 0-3), (B) perf sweep + infra packaging (day 4-10), (C) partner review and signoff (day 11-15).

sanjay: agree. owners: olivia for perf, alex for infra, maria for partner comms. I'll be overall PM.

olivia: question on telemetry — do we push full traces to our telemetry or provide a redacted CSV? Zion's SDK emits device counters I don't want to land in prod telemetry without opt-in.

sanjay: keep telemetry off prod path. collect locally on the dev pool and push an anonymized summary to the partnership folder. add a telemetry schema header so Priya can scan for PII.

priya-legal: +1. require a fields checklist: no user prompt content, no customer identifiers, aggregated to 1-minute buckets. I'll attach to the folder.

ecosys-bot: Reminder: create partner repo under org-private/zion-integration — repo created: org-private/zion-integration (private).

alex: added initial terraform stub and README to that repo. linking the run instructions here: https://github.com/org-private/zion-integration/blob/main/README.md

maria: timeline check — Zion asked about a soft joint post after signoff. given the 30-day embargo, we should aim for a co-announcement window ~week 3 if all goes perfectly, otherwise push to a later cadence.

sanjay: noted. prioritize perf stability over rush. small ask to org: anyone on-call for quick troubleshooting when devkit lands (Thu)? ping me if you can spare 1-2 hours.

olivia: I can cover Thu morning.

alex: I can be on standby Thu afternoon.

maria: I'll draft a short partner one-pager for Zion (what we'll run, deliverables, timings) and share for review by EOD today.

sanjay: perfect. last thing — let's add a quick rollback policy in the README: if p99 latency increases >2x over baseline, halt and open incident. simple stopgap to avoid shipping bad results.

olivia: added that to the suite runner (config flag: --abort-on-degradation).

sanjay: great. thanks team. I'll update the partnerskanban card and move to `pilot: in progress`.
